purpose: Settle, with live evidence, the two questions that decide the whole acquisition design. The skill forbids shipping an unverified mechanism claim.
corpus_audio_sent: NONE. Every request used a synthetic sine tone or a small PUBLIC sample clip.

STEP_0_CONSENT_GATE.requirement: One request WITH mip_opt_out=true and one WITHOUT. Both must be accepted. 'Declare the gate passed only if both return 200.'
STEP_0_CONSENT_GATE.note: Acceptance of the flag is NOT permission to stop sending it. The flag remains structural in the pipeline.

Q2_MP4_CONTAINER.question: Does the recogniser accept a video container and extract audio server-side?

first_attempt.CLASSIFICATION: harness_artefact - NOT a property of the provider
first_attempt.why: The first probe used a 4-second SINE TONE, which contains no speech. Zero words is the correct output for ANY accepted format. The probe could not distinguish 'container rejected' from 'container accepted, nothing to transcribe'.

retest.method: Downloaded a small PUBLIC speech clip (2287520 bytes), wrapped it locally in an MP4 container (218546 bytes), and POSTed BOTH the raw WAV and the MP4 so the two are directly comparable.
retest.strength: Not merely a 200. The MP4 and WAV produce identical utterance counts, identical paragraph counts, identical word counts and identical text - an equivalence result, not an acceptance code.

Q2_MP4_CONTAINER.CONSEQUENCE: The local ffmpeg transcode step is REMOVED for the 265.73 h MP4-only half of the corpus. Audio extraction happens server-side.

Q3_URL_FETCH.question: Can the recogniser retrieve media itself from an https URL, so neither download nor upload passes through this machine?
Q3_URL_FETCH.method: POSTed JSON {'url': <public audio URL>} with the same parameters.

result.sample: Yeah. As as much as, it's worth celebrating, the first, spacewalk, with an all female team...

Q3_URL_FETCH.caveat: This proves Deepgram will fetch an https URL. It does NOT prove it can fetch a MEGA direct-download URL. MEGA URLs are short-lived tokens and may be protected against hotlinking. THAT remains unproven and must be probed after the operator authenticates.

WHAT_IS_NOW_ELIMINATED.local_ffmpeg_transcode: ELIMINATED - MP4 containers are accepted and decoded server-side.
WHAT_IS_NOW_ELIMINATED.local_bandwidth: ELIMINATED ONLY IF the MEGA URL route works. Not yet proven. It also requires an authenticated MEGA account, because anonymous sessions cannot read file attributes and therefore cannot mint per-file URLs.

WHAT_REMAINS_UNPROVEN: Whether Deepgram can retrieve a MEGA direct-download URL. Two independent unknowns compound here: token lifetime, and whether MEGA serves the URL to a third-party fetch.
Whether MEGA's expiring URLs survive long enough for an asynchronous/batch fetch, versus only a synchronous request issued immediately after minting.

spend.probe_cost: negligible - three seconds of synthetic tone plus one ~30-second public clip, twice. Far below one cent.
spend.corpus_spend: ZERO. No corpus audio has been sent.
